# HPKE known-answer vector

Selected base-mode X25519/HKDF-SHA256/ChaCha20Poly1305 case, first three sequential encryptions, from the HPKE authors' original RFC vector set at revision `5f503c5`, shipped unchanged by hpke 0.14.1 as `test-vectors/origrfc-5f503c5.json`. Source full-file SHA-256: `61fc662f01996cd06d713dacf5e133167bd309a1f329442d53f1e21a47b3ede6`.

Upstream: https://github.com/cfrg/draft-irtf-cfrg-hpke/tree/5f503c5
The keys and plaintexts here are public test fixtures, never production credentials.
